from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Represents a single paper document and its outgoing citation links."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper as written")
    referenced_paper_titles: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of papers this document explicitly references")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregation of all extracted papers from the collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
